**Finding: deviation (WARRANTY)**

Section 5 warrants only legal compliance (knowledge-qualified), authority/rights and non-infringement, plus anti-bribery covenants — there is no express warranty that the Services or Works will conform to the Specifications/documentation, no warranty period, no malicious-code warranty, and no remedy. Section 1(b)'s "professional and workmanlike" covenant carries no remedy, and 5(e) disclaims all implied warranties, leaving Clear Capital effectively without a conformance warranty.

Redline (validated, `ok:true`): new Paragraph 5(f) adding (i) workmanlike Services, (ii) 12-month conformity of the Works to Specifications/documentation, (iii) no malicious code, with a repair/replace/re-perform-or-refund remedy, and a confirmation that 5(e) does not disclaim these express warranties. The comment offers the playbook fallback of 90 days (Works) / 30 days (Services) with the same remedies.
